clocks: closes on the FIFO clock (settle_ms = UUIDv7 creation, an upper bound of each match); residual to END / resolution
descriptive: consumed days; no strategy or profitability claim
fees: primary: fee_fill (fill price, V-free); sensitivity: fee_res (resolution)
population: resolved markets of each scope and day (others counted)
question: is completed turnover good and then lost through residual exposure, or is the completed turnover itself poor?
rule: turnover_itself_poor: close net (fee_fill) <= 1e-09; good_turnover_lost_to_residual: close net > 1e-09 and residual value to resolution < -1e-09; else good_turnover_residual_not_negative; no_rows / no_resolved_markets / no_closes first; sensitivity: fees at resolution (close net_feeres; residual value - its fee_res)
